description: Error chain: publish_and_wait called from inside a running asyncio event loop (ADK --agent path) raises 'asyncio.run() cannot be called when another event loop is running'. OMN-12660.
trigger: ADK agent calls publish_and_wait synchronously while an asyncio event loop is already running
location: SEA pipeline publish_and_wait — sync surface that internally calls asyncio.run()
wrong_behavior: RuntimeError: This event loop is already running — publish_and_wait hangs or raises before the delegation command reaches the bus
correct_behavior: publish_and_wait detects a running loop and uses loop.run_until_complete() or equivalent non-blocking path; both sync and running-loop callers complete the same round-trip
branch_context: Fix e0350d84 is on jonah/omn-12587-f1-loop-aware-publish, NOT on dev as of 2026-06-03

observable_signal.message_pattern: This event loop is already running

failure_mode: Delegation command never reaches bus; no consumer group event; SEA --agent returns immediately with no output
regression_guard: publish_and_wait must succeed when called from both a plain sync context AND from inside a running asyncio loop (e.g. ADK --agent). Both paths must complete the same round-trip.
test_requirement: Test must exercise the running-loop path, not just a plain sync call
